name: 55119 · Saint Paul, MN
findings: ZIP 55119 (Saint Paul) has 87 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 29 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55119 (Saint Paul) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 55119 (Saint Paul) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 53% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 26 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.
